title: Enhancing LLM-Based Human-Robot Interaction with Nuances for Diversity Awareness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the steady-state usage distribution and prompt token cost ('diversity cost') of incorporating user nationality information into LLM prompts to generate culturally-aware robot responses.

Measuring the usage distribution and token cost of incorporating a user's physical condition into LLM prompts, alongside a qualitative real-world evaluation of the robot interacting with an ex-hospitalized paraplegic user.
Measuring the steady-state usage distribution and prompt token cost of incorporating a user's mental condition information into LLM prompts to dynamically adapt dialogue generation.
